title: NARA Worked With Trump Representatives to Locate Records and Transfer 15 Boxes
description_short: NARA said it worked with Trump representatives in 2021 to locate untransferred presidential records; in January 2022 it arranged transport of 15 boxes from Mar-a-Lago.
description_medium: NARA said it worked during 2021 with Trump representatives to locate presidential records not transferred at the end of his administration. A representative told the agency in December 2021 that some records had been located, after which NARA arranged secure transport to Washington. Separately, NARA said it arranged transport of 15 boxes of presidential records from Mar-a-Lago in mid-January 2022; representatives said they were continuing to search for additional records.
description_long: The National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) described its work with representatives of former President Donald Trump to locate presidential records that had not been transferred at the end of his administration. NARA said it obtained their cooperation during 2021. The agency reported that in December 2021, a representative told it that some records had been located; NARA then arranged secure transport of those records to Washington. NARA also said that in mid-January 2022 it arranged transport from Mar-a-Lago to the Archives of 15 boxes containing presidential records, following discussions with Trump’s representatives during 2021. The agency said the representatives were continuing to search for additional presidential records belonging to the National Archives. NARA stated that, under the Presidential Records Act, these records should have been transferred from the White House at the end of the administration in January 2021. It also said NARA officials did not visit or ‘raid’ the Mar-a-Lago property. This account documents the agency’s reported search and transfer timeline; it does not identify individual records beyond the 15 boxes or provide dates for each communication with Trump’s representatives.

The source supports continued searching, but not a specific inventory or request-by-request timeline.
